Based on Goldman Sachs's most recent 10-K filing with the SEC, here are the details:

| Fiscal Year | Period End | Revenue |
|---|---|---|
| FY 2025 | December 31, 2025 | **$58.28 billion** |

**Key details:**
- **Filing date:** February 25, 2026
- **Reported metric:** Net Revenues (reported as *Revenues Net of Interest Expense*, which is the standard revenue measure for investment banks, as it nets out interest costs from interest income)
- **Value:** $58,283,000,000

> 📌 **Note on bank revenue reporting:** Unlike most companies, banks and financial firms like Goldman Sachs typically report *net revenues* (revenues net of interest expense) rather than gross revenues, since interest income and expense are core parts of their business. This is the standard metric used to gauge top-line performance for financial institutions.
